THE BUILD

The thinking behind the page.

A useful project has to connect its interface to the visitor’s task.

Audience

People who need a clear path into DailyScope and an interface they can understand quickly.

Experience

Automated publication, source attribution, quiz archives and regenerated discovery files.

Next iteration

Review real visitor feedback and refine the areas where people hesitate or need more context.

Interface decisions

An article archive needs clear categories, concise answers and visible sources. DailyScope connects current affairs, people profiles and static GK with dated quizzes.

What I would keep refining

The publishing workflow updates the complete archive and discovery files, while keeping previous quiz sets accessible. Search indexing and rankings remain dependent on the search engines.
